name: analytics-and-perf

lighthouse.environment_caveat: Measurements taken on x64 Node + Rosetta-translated Chrome on Mac Silicon. Lighthouse CLI itself refuses this combo because of Rosetta perf overhead. LCP numbers are inflated vs. real prod; CLS/INP measurements are still reliable. Prod measurement should re-run from a clean arm64 Node or from PageSpeed Insights against the deployed Vercel URL.

thresholds.inp_pass: not measurable via Lighthouse (lab tool); needs RUM
thresholds.note: PRD §성능 thresholds use 75th-percentile RUM in prod. prototype 단계는 측정·기록만 (PRD §5.1). LCP miss to be revisited in retrospective(phase 13) — likely Rosetta artifact; verify against deployed Vercel URL with PageSpeed Insights.

retrospective_followups: Re-measure CWV against deployed bsides.kr via PageSpeed Insights (real-device + real CrUX field data).
If LCP still > 2.5s in prod, investigate Google Fonts subsetting + Pretendard payload + above-fold critical CSS.
